create_instances_from_point_annotations: create an Instances object from point annotations with optional point subsampling for point-supervised detection models
transform_point_annotations: apply geometric transforms to point coordinates and labels marking out-of-boundary points as unlabeled
subsample_point_coords: subsample point coordinates and labels to a fixed count per instance during training iterations
review_annotations_to_instances: review the annotations_to_instances function that converts dataset dicts to Instances with gt_point_coords and gt_point_labels fields
review_transform_instance_annotations: review the transform_instance_annotations function that applies transforms to box and point annotations for a single instance
